title: Tesla's Unsupervised Robotaxi Network Expands to 7 US Cities
summary:
The electric vehicle maker's autonomous ride hailing fleet began operations in Fort Worth, Texas, at 6 a.m. CT on Nov. 2. The launch makes Fort Worth the latest addition to Tesla's fleet of unsupervised Robotaxis, which now serves a total of 7 US cities and marks the company's first market expansion for the service in about 3 months.

The new deployment in Fort Worth covers a 143 square mile geofence and joins active zones in Austin, Houston, Dallas, Miami, Orlando, and Tampa. Across these 7 cities, Tesla's total unsupervised geofences now cover roughly 1% of the total U.S. population.
